run.answer:

Hamilton ran a one-stop, Medium to Soft, pitting on lap 33. The model's verdict is "agrees": none of the alternatives it tried is clearly faster.

- The closest alternative is Medium to Hard with the stop on lap 34. It comes out 0.5 s faster, and it was faster in 20 of 20 refits. Its range across pit-loss assumptions runs from 1.2 s faster to 1.3 s slower. It also runs tyres older than any seen at this circuit, so that number is an extrapolation.
- The other alternatives are slower by 12.0 s to 25.7 s. They include Hard to Medium, earlier one-stops and two-stops.

How far to trust it: moderately. The 80% interval on a gap is about ±15.9 s, so a 0.5 s difference is well within the noise. The model also can't see undercuts or sudden tyre drop-off. It replayed the real safety car and virtual safety car on lap 33.
